specification_compliance: Commit 72a6773f2 changes one comment line in tests/test_ci_browser_jobs.py (now lines 244-245). It deletes the clause 'and nothing lets a test step run without it'. That is the second option proposed by r4 CD-1 and CR4-1, and the comment now claims only what test_fonts_step_installs_the_user_fontconfig checks: that the step copies the repository file to $HOME/.config/fontconfig/fonts.conf, with no if and no continue-on-error.

The commit changes no product file. In the working tree, ci.yml:302-409 (both browser jobs, including the fonts steps at 343-347 and 390-394 and the EPUB gate at 407), ci.yml:509-513 (bootstrap install), check-playwright-browsers.mjs (88 lines) and playwright-fonts.conf (6 lines) match the quoted branch diff. I1, I2, I3, I4 wiring, I5, I8, I9, I10 and I12 hold as they did in r4.

The EPUB `if` still references only steps.browsers. That matches spec item 2 and I8 as written, and the job is red whenever the fonts step fails. Since this commit removed the comment, no prose claims otherwise, so the r4 mismatch between the code and the test comment is gone.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The behavior behind r4 CD-1/CR4-1 is unchanged by design. If the fonts step fails while the browser check passed, the EPUB step still runs under the image's default fallback font. The job is already red at the fonts step, so nothing passes silently. The spec does not say whether the EPUB step should also gate on steps.fonts. This commit chose to correct the comment and leave the gate as it is.
regression_risks: None from this commit. It edits a comment and has no executable effect.

r4 CD-2 still applies: test_fonts_conf_prefers_liberation_sans (tests/test_ci_browser_jobs.py:276-279) does not read the alias `binding` attribute, so dropping binding="strong" from playwright-fonts.conf:4-5 keeps the pytest green. Only the layout suite's exact-height assertion would catch a resulting font drift, and it would fail loudly.
test_coverage: Mutation in thought for this commit: it changes no assertion, so the set of killed and surviving mutants is the same as in r4. Removing the fonts step, reordering it, or adding an if or continue-on-error to it is killed by test_browser_job_step_order and test_fonts_step_installs_the_user_fontconfig. Adding `&& steps.fonts.outcome == 'success'` to the EPUB if is killed by test_layout_epub_job_runs_both_suites, because EPUB_IF pins the spec's string. Removing binding="strong" survives.
No test checks how the EPUB step behaves when the fonts step fails. No comment claims that any test checks this any more.
